nodes.label: v0.9.0-beta.6 Milestone: Clean-Machine Reliability and Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Beta 6 makes the portable beta dependable on clean Windows machines and teaches the main LecturePack workflow; authorised baseline v0.9.0-beta.5, tag v0.9.0-beta.5, commit 459faf5.

nodes.label: Deterministic Runtime Contract
nodes.rationale: A clean installation must deterministically establish and persist a healthy bundled CPU processing runtime before any normal application behavior begins; lightweight checks run every launch, full smoke checks run on first launch, after update/repair, or when payload identity changes.

nodes.label: Required-Runtime Hard Setup Gate
nodes.rationale: If any required component is missing or corrupt, users cannot enter the main app until checks pass; healthy first launches initialize silently and continue to the empty Home screen.

nodes.label: Repair All Action
nodes.rationale: Failed checks offer one consented Repair all action showing source and download details; successful repair revalidates everything and enters LecturePack automatically without restart.

nodes.label: Optional Engine Fallback
nodes.rationale: A healthy optional CUDA or custom engine remains selected across upgrade; a broken optional engine falls back to bundled CPU with a visible notice and never triggers the hard gate when bundled CPU is healthy.

nodes.label: Empty Launch and Ownership
nodes.rationale: Startup never auto-opens the latest completed lecture; Home begins with no active lecture and existing jobs open only after explicit user action; no design-time, packaged, or demo lecture may appear as a permanent normal job.

nodes.label: Guided Onboarding Tour
nodes.rationale: After the first successful runtime check a welcome choice Start guided demo or Skip for now is shown without auto-start; tour is concise with user-controlled Next/Back steps, arrows, circles and spotlights anchored to the interface, a persistent Exit demo action, and is replayable from Settings.

nodes.label: Synthetic Demo Lecture
nodes.rationale: Bundle an original synthetic 45-90 second lecture with simple slides and narration containing no university, student, or third-party copyrighted content; processed through the real offline pipeline from import through study-pack generation and export-location explanation.

nodes.label: Isolated Demo Workspace
nodes.rationale: Demo work uses an isolated temporary workspace, never appears in the library, is deleted on normal exit, and is swept safely after cancellation or crash.

nodes.label: Beta-5 Visual Preservation
nodes.rationale: Preserve beta 5's animation language, timing, transitions, hard dark shadows, and pressed/embedded button effect; do not redesign or reduce the intentional visual character; changes limited to removing unintended flicker, flashes, repaint artifacts, overflow, and layout jumps.

nodes.label: Atomic Theme Switching
nodes.rationale: Theme switching is atomic so the whole palette changes in one frame without unintended per-element color flashes; long local-model names use ellipsis with the full value available by tooltip on hover/focus.

nodes.label: Signed Manifest Repair
nodes.rationale: Repair downloads come only from the official LecturePack GitHub release for the exact running app version; beta 6 embeds a project public key, verifies a project-signed manifest, and checks every payload with SHA-256 before installation; never mix runtime components across releases.

nodes.label: Transactional Repair
nodes.rationale: Repair is transactional: download and verify into staging, replace only after the full set passes, and restore the previous runtime on any failure; repair network access requires explicit user action with no telemetry or unrelated network requests.

nodes.label: Clean-Machine Release Gate
nodes.rationale: Public beta 6 is blocked until physical Windows coverage exists for CPU-only, NVIDIA, and AMD/Intel graphics machines with both fresh and upgraded profiles; a fully offline fresh-profile test must launch, pass bundled-runtime checks, process the bundled demo, review results, and export successfully.

nodes.label: ConfigManager
nodes.rationale: Research finding: ConfigManager initializes all four core paths as empty.

nodes.label: engine_adapter.py (Desktop Adapter)
nodes.rationale: Startup ownership, processing gate, and desktop bridge integration; the desktop adapter validates empty Whisper paths before processing reaches engine discovery; startup currently calls _load_latest_completed_job() and activates an existing lecture.

nodes.label: Whisper Discovery
nodes.rationale: Research finding: Whisper discovery exists but is called only by diagnostics; FFmpeg auto-detects during controller construction.

nodes.label: LECTUREPACK_DATA_DIR
nodes.rationale: Existing disposable-profile seam suitable for packaged tests.

nodes.label: Release Verification Gap (beta.7 findings)
nodes.rationale: STATE.md recorded milestone_complete (22/22 plans) but the claim did not survive first contact with a clean device; the Phase 5 release gate never recorded installer size, launch time, or any physical machine identity, and its evidence cites beta-5 artifacts while certifying beta-6. Engineering content (runtime contract, signed-repair design, AD-18/AD-19) remains canonical; the release verification is not.

nodes.label: Verifier/Signing ADR
nodes.rationale: An explicitly approved ADR must define the signed-manifest verifier, trust/key lifecycle, canonical manifest/versioned asset contract, and PyInstaller validation required before repair implementation; Phase 2 implementation is blocked until this ADR is approved.

nodes.label: AD-18: Unicode-safe Whisper Staging
nodes.rationale: Keep Unicode paths end-to-end while staging only whisper.cpp v1.9.1 native CLI arguments under private ASCII paths; optional VAD models use the same private ASCII native staging boundary so no Unicode source path may reach whisper.cpp.

nodes.label: AD-19: Ed25519 Signed Manifest
nodes.rationale: AD-19 approves cryptography==49.0.0 and pure Ed25519 detached signatures over exact canonical manifest bytes; release metadata is authenticated as exact raw Ed25519 bytes before parsing; signature verification occurs before any parse or reserialization.

nodes.label: Release Trust Root
nodes.rationale: The release trust root will be compiled into a future application release; Phase 2 implementation remains deferred.

nodes.label: Backend Runtime Admission
nodes.rationale: Backend owns runtime admission and constructs no adapter before HEALTHY; runtime admission rejects incomplete full-validation evidence and only complete trusted component evidence is persisted; failed runtime launch or validator exceptions are untrusted evidence and cannot persist health or resolve optional engines.
